title: Spectral Brew Post-Process Mixer
description: A skull floats above a coffee mug emitting ghostly steam. The user mixes post-processing effects by adjusting coupled parameters: bloom intensity, chromatic aberration, film grain, vignette, and color grading channels. A conservation law ensures total effect 'energy' stays at a fixed budget, so increasing one effect automatically reduces others. Undo/redo lets the user navigate their mixing history.
prompt: Create a single HTML file using Three.js r170 with EffectComposer from three/addons. Load coffeeMug.glb centered at (0,-1,0) and ScatteringSkull.glb floating at (0,1.5,0) with a gentle bobbing animation. Use a PerspectiveCamera at (0,1.5,5) looking at origin. Add warm point light inside the mug and cool directional light on the skull. Set dark background color #0a0a12. Implement these 5 post-processing parameters as sliders in an HTML overlay panel on the left: (1) Bloom intensity 0-100, (2) Chromatic Aberration 0-100, (3) Film Grain 0-100, (4) Vignette darkness 0-100, (5) Color Shift hue rotation 0-100. Implement a CONSERVATION LAW: total sum of all 5 sliders must always equal exactly 200. When the user drags one slider up by N, distribute -N proportionally across the other four sliders (clamped to 0-100, redistributing remainder). Display the current total prominently to prove conservation. Implement MULTI-INPUT COUPLING: bloom and chromatic aberration are linked — the skull's emissive glow color shifts from blue to red as chromatic aberration exceeds bloom. Film grain intensity modulates the bobbing speed of the skull. Vignette and color shift together control the mug's rim light color via HSL mixing. Add an UNDO/REDO system: store slider state snapshots on each slider release. Show Undo and Redo buttons that restore previous/next states. Display step counter showing current position in history (e.g. 'Step 3/7'). Use UnrealBloomPass for bloom, write custom ShaderPass instances for chromatic aberration (RGB channel offset), film grain (random noise overlay), vignette (radial darkening), and color shift (hue rotation matrix). OrbitControls enabled. All 5 sliders, conservation redistribution, coupled visual feedback, and undo/redo with at least 10 meaningful interaction steps required.
